stories.title: Councillors demand answers on £55m Catholic super-school as debt and governance concerns mount
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is being asked to demand answers from Cabinet over why taxpayers face an estimated £30 million borrowing bill for a Catholic super-school building that would be handed to the Diocese of Wrexham on completion. stories.title: Flintshire firm’s staff complete 53-mile coast relay from Conwy to Saltney
stories.summary: Colleagues from P&A Group completed a 53-mile charity relay along the North Wales Coast Path on Saturday 13 June, raising around £1,500 for Tenovus Cancer Care and North Wales Wildlife Trust. stories.title: More than 600 homeless households in Flintshire as MS urges new Welsh Government to act
stories.summary: Ken Skates MS is calling on the new Welsh Government to commit to ending homelessness in Wales by 2034, as figures show 633 households in Flintshire are currently classed as homeless. stories.title: Energie Fitness Deeside owners launch new pilates studio at Broughton Retail Park
stories.summary: A new reformer pilates studio is opening at Broughton Retail Park on Monday 29 June, run by the same local couple behind Energie Fitness Deeside. Glyn and Nathalie Stephens are launching Reformer by Energie Chester Broughton, offering reformer pilates classes, hot classes and pre- and post-natal sessions.
